Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

I like / I don’t like
PersonPositive (+)Negative (–)
II like coffee.I don’t like Mondays.
  • Use I like + a thing you enjoy.
  • Use I don’t like + a thing you don’t enjoy.
  • It is a fixed phrase — just add the word.

→ he likes / she likes comes later (Lesson 13).

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: like → I like coffee. Say no: add don't — I don't like Mondays.
  • ⚠ In Russian and Kazakh you can drop 'I' (люблю кофе · кофе ұнатамын). English always needs I: I like coffee.

Stage 4 · Practice

Practice A

Read. Then choose True or False.

These are classroom words.

1👂 Listen means “use your ears”.
2🔁 Repeat means “say it again”.
3❓ Answer means “ask a question”.
4🐢 Slowly means “very fast”.
5👀 Look at means “use your eyes”.
6🔗 Match means “put two things together”.
7🙋 Ask means “give an answer”.
8🙏 Sorry is a polite word.
9🙏 Please is a polite word.
10🔄 Again means “one more time”.
Why these answers

Answer = give a reply. Ask = say a question. Slowly = not fast.

Part 3 — Transform: rewrite the sentence as asked.

1Make it negative: I like Mondays.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two sentences: one thing you like, one you don’t like.

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

I like coffee and music. I don’t like Mondays.

Check yourself:

  • Did you use I like …?
  • Did you use I don’t like …?
  • One idea per line — short and clear?
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi! I’m Sam. 👋

Sam

Do you like coffee? ☕

Sam

Nice! Me too — I like coffee. ☕

Sam

Do you like Mondays? 📅

Sam

Ha! I don’t like Mondays. 😅

Sam

Now listen carefully. I say: “I likes music.” 🎵

Why

With I we say “I like”, never “I likes”. The -s comes only with he/she (later).

Sam

Yes! “I like music.” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

You did well: you answered every question and caught my mistake. Next time, try to say your answers out loud too.
